verdict.rationale: Bevy documents cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, Linux, Web, iOS, and Android (bevy-docs-6, bevy-docs-31), with community confirmation that iOS mobile builds run well (bevy-comm-10) — covering the desktop and mobile export halves of the story. However, there is no mention anywhere in the evidence of console export, console partner programs, or any official/unofficial path to PlayStation/Xbox/Switch, which is a core part of this studio-lead story. Missing for 10: console export (direct or via partner), any console SDK/partner program documentation, evidence of shipped console titles.
